_comment: Third-party proof, in one place. Read by the React site (socialProof.ts),
by scripts/generate-landing-pages.mjs, and asserted by
scripts/check-landing-pages.mjs.
Nothing in this file may be written from memory. Every field is either read
off the third-party page by a human on the date in `asOf` / `retrieved`, or
it does not go in. The review texts are verbatim: they are published on
Trustpilot and Product Hunt under these authors' names, so a tidy-up here is
a misquote of a real person. check-landing-pages.mjs keeps its own second
copy of the three Trustpilot texts on purpose, so an edit here that nobody
checked against the live page fails the build rather than shipping.
Product Hunt has three states, and the badge picks whichever the data
supports:
1. `embedProductId` set  -> Product Hunt's own review widget, which draws
the live star rating and review count from their servers. Nothing is
copied here, so nothing can go stale. The id is in the embed code on
the product's Promote page. This is the one to use.
2. `rating` + `reviews` set -> drawn locally, same shape as Trustpilot,
with `asOf` recording the day a human read them.
3. neither -> a plain 'Find us on Product Hunt' link, and the review
section does not render. An empty block ships a smaller true claim; a
filled-in guess ships a false one.

reviews.author: Devansh Patel
reviews.text: Honestly, TopEdge AI completely changed how we handle customer support and sales on our Shopify store. The WhatsApp automation is rock solid—it takes care of everything from catching abandoned carts and confirming COD orders to sending out tracking updates and warranty info. The whole setup was super smooth, and I really appreciate the transparent pricing with no hidden surprises. If you're running a D2C brand in India, this tool is honestly a no-brainer.
